questions.title: Comprehensive Event-Driven Architecture
questions.question:
Design a comprehensive event-driven architecture for a real-time order fulfillment system.

System Flow:
1. Customer places order → OrderCreated event
2. Inventory reserves items → InventoryReserved event
3. Payment processes → PaymentProcessed event
4. Warehouse picks items → ItemsPicked event
5. Shipping creates label → ShippingLabelCreated event
6. Carrier picks up → OrderShipped event
7. Customer receives → OrderDelivered event
8. At any point: failures trigger compensation events

Requirements:
- Process 10,000 orders/hour during peak
- Guarantee exactly-once processing for payments
- Event ordering per order
- 99.9% availability
- Full audit trail (event sourcing)
- Real-time notifications to customers
- Analytics on order processing times
- Handle failures at any step (Saga pattern)
- Support event replay for bug fixes
- Multi-region deployment

Design should cover:
1. Event schema for all domain events
2. Event store implementation
3. Event bus architecture (Kafka topics/partitions)
4. Partition key strategy for ordering
5. Saga orchestration for order workflow
6. Idempotency implementation
7. Transactional outbox pattern for reliable publishing
8. Dead letter queue handling
9. Event versioning strategy
10. CQRS read models for queries
11. Snapshot strategy for performance
12. Event monitoring and alerting
13. Testing strategy for event flows
14. Failure scenarios and compensation

Include: event schemas, topic design, consumer groups, sequence diagrams, and compensation flows.
